topic: Testing data transfer speeds and limits
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on testing data retrieval performance. [me] reported an initial speed of approximately 40MB/s when tested with 'colda'. However, the transfer was found to be limited by IOPS rather than overall bandwidth (traffic), especially during long queries. The underlying hardware is noted as a magnetic HDD (not SSD). Due to these limitations, [me] questioned whether maintaining a 'hot' status for the data was advisable and planned further testing when load was low.
decisions: The current standard configuration was restored.
action_items: [me] will test performance again during periods of low load.
